content: Groq: use openai python SDK with base_url=https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, api_key=GROQ_API_KEY. Mostly OpenAI-compatible; logprobs and a few fields unsupported (400 error if sent). Official groq-python SDK (pypi 'groq' v1.5.0) also available but OpenAI-compatible client is simpler for a single swappable client module.
